result.title: Quantifying Local and Global Fidelity of Nonlinear Embeddings
result.summary: Dimension reduction methods are chosen by a common claim: t-SNE and UMAP preserve local structure, and PCA preserves global structure. Checking it on given data takes local and global scores on one scale and a test that compares two maps. Both scores come from one curve. The locality profile is the chance-corrected share of each point's k nearest neighbors that a map keeps, over all neighborhood sizes. Its value at k = 10 is the local fidelity L, and its mean over 30 to 50 percent of the data is the global fidelity G. We prove that at the midpoint the profile is the agreement on which half of the data is near each point, a rank correlation of the distances. Because L and G are one statistic, two maps can be tested against each other. The LG reversal test applies to any two dimension reduction methods. It decides, with a block-jackknife p-value, whether one map is more local and the other more global, and returns the scale at which to change maps. On 156 maps of twelve datasets with up to 1.38 million points, G agrees with established global scores at 0.89 and 0.96, and 2,000 points estimate it. The test confirms the usual claim on seven datasets. On both retail datasets and both rolled-up manifolds, it finds the neighbor embeddings more global. In an agent memory of one million passages, the two maps cross at 150,000 passages (p = 2.6e-5). Applications span pathology, single cells, supply chains and AI agent memory.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出用一条「locality profile」曲线统一刻画降维嵌入的局部与全局保真度：k=10 处取值为局部保真度 L，在 30%–50% 邻域规模上的均值为全局保真度 G，并证明中点处该曲线等价于距离的秩相关；据此设计 LG reversal test，用 block-jackknife p 值判断两张映射谁更局部、谁更全局并给出切换尺度，在 12 个数据集共 156 张映射上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 该局部/全局保真度统一度量与两两比较检验，可供核查 latent 或 VLM 内部状态是否同时保留局部视觉细节与全局任务结构，但它是无监督嵌入几何工具，对推理状态与答案因果作用的适用性需进一步确认。
